The '''MK-II shuttle''' was a ship used by the [[Eternal Empire]]. In [[3631 BBY]] [[Koth Vortena]] stole two of these shuttles when he and [[Lana Beniko]] came to [[Zakuul]] to [[Rescue of the Outlander|rescue]] [[Alliance Commander|the Outlander]].<ref name="KOTET 3" />

The [[Eternal Alliance]] frequently utilized this shuttle during its operations including when destroying [[Star Fortress]]es.
